criteria.criterion: GIS screen can be opened from launcher
steps_taken: Opened the authenticated V4 launcher at /launcher.
Selected the GIS module's Open module control.
Captured the immediate GIS loading state.
Waited for the GIS workspace to finish loading.
Verified the GIS heading, layer groups, map canvas, map controls, and profile control were visible.
criteria.actual_result: The GIS workspace opened from the launcher and loaded successfully, with the GIS heading, layer groups, map canvas, map controls, and profile control visible.
